digest.component_or_area: file-impact declaration and tri-state scope model
propositions: The current empty file_impact value conflates two distinct states: author omission and explicit no-impact declaration; the system must distinguish these by adding a tri-state model (undeclared, paths, none).

FILE_IMPACT event payload must carry optional file_impact_scope and no_file_impact_reason keys; reducer state must persist both and derive the tri-state via a pure helper function based on file_impact contents and payload scope.

CLI set-file-impact command must support two mutually exclusive forms: JSON array of paths (legacy) and --none with a reason string (new), enforcing exactly one form and rejecting reasons with fewer than 10 non-whitespace characters.
The command must migrate from _REGISTRY (fixed arity) to _ARGV_REGISTRY (variadic) to support the --none flag without silent argv truncation.
Library function get_file_impact_scope must return a dict with kind, reason, and paths; MCP tool declare_no_file_impact must apply identical reason validation and write state without outputSchema.

State transitions between all three tri-state pairs (undeclared ↔ paths, undeclared ↔ none, paths ↔ none) must be tested; existing get-file-impact output and rebar show display must remain stable except for new state keys on declared-none tickets.
